rules.title: Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must give tenants the city's Tenants Rights and Resources Guide at the start of a tenancy and whenever legal steps to end a tenancy (e.g., Notice to Quit or Summary Process) are taken. The ordinance does not bar evictions otherwise allowed by law.
rules.key_value: Guide required at tenancy start and at termination; $300 per day fine
rules.quoted_span: The Ordinance also requires that a landlord provide the Guide to tenants when legal steps to terminate a tenancy are taken (ex. Notice to Quit or Summary Process).
rules.effective_date_note: Page posted 10/14/2020; ordinance effective date not stated in the document.
rules.exemptions: Rental units in a hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility, or in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is short-term substance abuse treatment; short-term rental units under Cambridge Zoning Ordinance Art. 4, § 4.60. Applies to owner-occupied single units.
rules.penalty: Fine of $300 for each day's violation (Sec. 8.71.070).

unverifiable_exemptions: hospital, skilled nursing or health facility units
non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities

parsed.doc_summary: Cambridge city page on Ch. 8.71, a notification ordinance requiring landlords to give tenants a rights and resources guide at tenancy start and when termination steps are taken. It does not limit eviction grounds. $300/day fine; limited exemptions.
